QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Brace Yourself, Horntail!
QuestInfo.0: You are all set to attack Horntail. Talk to Eremos.
QuestInfo.1: Eremos has tracked Horntail to its hiding place in the Cave of Life and made the necessary preparations for you to ambush its abode. It's time to take out Horntail.
QuestInfo.2: Your bold attempt to take down Horntail failed miserably despite all that preparation! You may have escaped with your life, but your pride has suffered a severe blow. Eremos blames the failure on Horntail's hidden power. Surana apologized, but the loss still stings.
